scene: The unfolded map reveals transit routes leading far out across the metropolis.
picture: Side-scrolling view along a bustling transit depot. On the far left, a wicker drone gondola floats by a dock. Granny in her pink tracksuit stands holding her dog and map. At centre, a hover metro train sits open. On the right, a winged flying scooter idles at a post.
shown: A wicker gondola slung beneath a quadcopter drone waiting at the far left canal quay.
A gleaming silver hover metro train stopped with doors open at the centre platform.
A pastel-blue flying scooter parked beside a charging post on the right.
